lt.line: Sakau jums: daugel pranašų ir karalių troško išvysti, ką jūs matote, bet neišvydo, ir išgirsti, ką jūs girdite, bet neišgirdo“.

en.event: Saturday of the Twenty-sixth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: For I say to you, many prophets and kings desired to see what you see, but did not see it, and to hear what you hear, but did not hear it.
